description: Triple-layer hardware encryption for USB drives - Hardware (AES-256-XTS) + Vault (AES-256-GCM) + Access Levels (1-4). Cross-platform support for Linux, Windows, macOS with TCG Opal 2.0 SED support and custom THC container format.

userStories.title: Create tesseract-hardware crate structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the foundational crate structure for hardware encryption so that platform-specific implementations can be built on top.
acceptanceCriteria: Add crate to workspace in root Cargo.toml
Create module structure: lib.rs, error.rs, detect.rs, container.rs, crypto.rs
Create platform module stubs: platform/mod.rs, linux.rs, windows.rs, macos.rs
Create SED module stubs: sed/mod.rs, opal.rs
Define public API traits and types in lib.rs
userStories.notes: Created tesseract-hardware crate with full module structure. error.rs (HardwareError enum), detect.rs (DriveInfo, DriveType), container.rs (ThcHeader, CipherSuite), crypto.rs (DualKeys, Xts256 stubs), platform/ (linux, windows, macos stubs), sed/ (opal stub). Note: cargo build could not be verified - Rust not installed in environment.

userStories.title: Implement AES-256-XTS encryption for containers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need AES-256-XTS encryption support so that drive containers can be encrypted with sector-level encryption.
acceptanceCriteria: Add aes and xts-mode dependencies to tesseract-crypto crate
Implement Xts256 struct with encrypt_sector/decrypt_sector methods
Support sector number as tweak value
Unit tests pass for encrypt/decrypt round-trip
Unit tests pass for known test vectors
userStories.notes: Created tesseract-crypto/src/xts.rs with Xts256 struct using aes 0.8 and xts-mode 0.5 crates. Features: configurable sector size (16-4096 bytes), sector number as tweak (little-endian), encrypt_sectors/decrypt_sectors for bulk operations. Tests: round-trip, different sectors produce different ciphertext, known test vectors, sector size validation. Hardware crate updated to re-export Xts256 from crypto crate.

userStories.title: Define THC container header format
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a standardized header format for Tesseract Hardware Containers so that encrypted drives can be identified and unlocked.
acceptanceCriteria: Define ThcHeader struct with all fields (magic, version, cipher, KDF params, salt, encrypted master key, MAC)
Implement ThcHeader::new() to create header with given password
Implement ThcHeader::unlock() to derive and verify master key
Magic bytes: TESS-HWC followed by null (8 bytes)

userStories.title: Implement dual-key derivation from master password
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to derive separate hardware and vault keys from a single master password so that one password unlocks both layers securely.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement derive_dual_keys(password, hw_salt, vault_salt, params) function
Use Argon2id for initial key derivation
Use HKDF-SHA256 to derive hardware key with context TESSERACT-HARDWARE-KEY
Use HKDF-SHA256 to derive vault key with context TESSERACT-SOFTWARE-KEY
Keys are cryptographically independent (compromising one does not reveal other)
Add HKDF implementation to tesseract-crypto if not present
